events.name: How Jaws Changed the World
events.description: Now 50 years old, Steven Spielberg's Jaws casts a long shadow on both the film industry and the fate of many shark species, leading to widespread slaughter around the world due to the fear it provoked in people. However, the movie also inspired a whole generation of marine biologists to specialise in sharks and this documentary reveals that much more is known now about this misunderstood species than ever before

Alan also provides viewers with some tips on sensory planting and creating home-made play equipment for children

Plus, music from classical star Alexis Ffrench

Alan also provides viewers with some tips on sensory planting and creating home-made play equipment for children

Plus, music from classical star Alexis Ffrench

As usual there will be lifelines, including 50:50, Ask the Audience, Phone a Friend, and Ask the Host. With up to £1 million on the table, who will hold their nerve under Jeremy Clarkson's gaze and can anyone beat Stephen Fry's impressive £250,000 win?
